note: Names, permissions and descriptions from Datadog's official MCP Server Tools reference. Cowork discovers the live tool list from the server; this catalog is reference material for the skills, not a substitute for tools/list.

uk1.note: Derived from Datadog's 'prepend mcp. to your site' rule; not listed in the six documented commercial MCP endpoints. Verify before use.

tools.name: search_datadog_hosts
tools.description: Lists and provides information about monitored hosts, supporting filtering and searching.

tools.name: search_datadog_metrics
tools.description: Lists available metrics, with options for filtering and metadata.

tools.name: get_datadog_metric_context
tools.description: Retrieves metric metadata, available tags and tag values for filtering and grouping.

tools.name: get_datadog_metric
tools.permissions: Metrics or Timeseries (or Cloud Cost Management Read)
tools.description: Queries and analyzes historical or real-time metric data, supporting custom queries and aggregations.

tools.name: search_datadog_monitors
tools.description: Retrieves monitors including statuses, thresholds and alert conditions.

tools.name: search_datadog_events
tools.description: Searches events such as monitor alerts, deployments, infrastructure changes, security findings and service status changes.

tools.name: search_datadog_incidents
tools.description: Lists incidents including state, severity and metadata.

tools.name: get_datadog_incident
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about an incident (timeline data not included).

tools.name: search_datadog_dashboards
tools.description: Lists available dashboards and key details; limited detail about contents.

tools.name: get_datadog_dashboard
tools.description: Retrieves a dashboard by ID with title, description, tags and widgets.

tools.name: search_datadog_logs
tools.permissions: Logs Read Data, Logs Read Index Data
tools.description: Searches logs with filters (time, query, service, host, storage tier) and returns log details.

tools.name: analyze_datadog_logs
tools.permissions: Logs Read Data, Logs Read Index Data, Timeseries
tools.description: Analyzes logs with SQL for counting, aggregation and numerical analysis.

tools.name: search_datadog_spans
tools.description: Retrieves APM spans with filters such as service, time and resource.

tools.name: get_datadog_trace
tools.description: Fetches a complete trace by trace ID; very large traces may be truncated.

tools.name: search_datadog_entities
tools.description: Searches the Software Catalog for service identity, ownership and upstream/downstream dependencies.

tools.name: search_datadog_notebooks
tools.description: Lists and searches notebooks by author, tags and content.

tools.name: get_datadog_notebook
tools.description: Retrieves a notebook by ID including name, status and author.

tools.name: search_datadog_rum_events
tools.description: Searches RUM events using advanced query syntax.

tools.name: aggregate_rum_events
tools.description: Aggregates RUM events (counts, averages, percentiles) with grouping.

tools.name: create_datadog_notebook
tools.description: Creates a new notebook.

tools.name: edit_datadog_notebook
tools.description: Edits an existing notebook.

tools.name: upsert_datadog_dashboard
tools.description: Creates or updates a dashboard.

optional_toolsets.llmobs: Agent Observability spans and experiments (LLM/agent traces).
